Prisjakt AB (publ) (“Prisjakt”, the “Company” or, together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”), one of the leading Nordic providers of comparison-shopping services, hereby announces the outcome of the initial public offering of the Company’s ordinary shares (the “Offering”) in connection with the listing of the ordinary shares on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market (together with the Offering, the “Listing”). The Offering attracted very strong interest from Nordic and international institutional investors as well as the general public in the Nordics. The Offering has been oversubscribed several times. Trading in the Company’s ordinary shares on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market commences today, 23 October 2026, under the ticker “PJ”.
Offering in brief
As previously announced, the price in the Offering was SEK 31 per ordinary share (the “
Offering Price
”), corresponding to a valuation of all ordinary shares in the Company of SEK 675 million.
The Offering comprised 6,625,748 existing ordinary shares, corresponding to approximately 30 per cent of the total number of ordinary shares in Prisjakt, that were offered by eEquity Growth V AB (“
eEquity

”) and the other existing shareholders in the Company, including members of the board of directors and group management[1], on a pro rata basis in relation to their shareholdings prior to the Offering (together, the “
Selling Shareholders

To cover overallotment in the Offering, eEquity and certain Selling Shareholders have undertaken to sell up to 993,862 additional existing ordinary shares, corresponding to a maximum of 15 per cent of the total number of ordinary shares in the Offering (the “
Overallotment Option

Provided that the Overallotment Option is exercised in full, the Offering will comprise 7,619,610 ordinary shares, which represent approximately 35 per cent of the total number of ordinary shares in the Company.
The total value of the Offering amounted to approximately SEK 205.4 million. Assuming that the Overallotment Option is exercised in full, the Offering will amount to approximately SEK 236.2 million.

In connection with the Listing, all Selling Shareholders have entered into lock-up undertakings. The lock-up period is 540 days from the first day of trading for eEquity, certain individual shareholders related to eEquity as well as for all members of the board of directors and group management. For all other Selling Shareholders, the lock-up period is 180, 360 and 540 days, with the lock-up on such ordinary shares being released in three equally sized tranches.
In connection with the Offering, Prisjakt welcomes more than 6,100 new shareholders in the Company.
Trading on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market commences today, 23 October 2026, under the trading symbol (ticker) “PJ”.
Settlement is expected to take place on 27 October 2026.
Peter Greberg, CEO of Prisjakt, comments:

“Today marks an important milestone for Prisjakt, and I would like to thank everyone who has contributed to our journey. We are entering our next phase with a strong position in the Nordics while continuing to expand internationally. We have established a leading position in specialised AI for shopping, and our new AI assistant marks the next major step in transforming how consumers find, compare and choose products. We have a clear strategy and ambitious goals for Prisjakt’s future as a listed company.”
Fredrik Malm, Chairman of the board of directors of Prisjakt, comments:

“Over the years, Prisjakt has built a strong position in the Nordics and earned consumers’ trust by providing independent, reliable information to help them make purchasing decisions. We have a profitable business and a strong foundation to build on. The listing is a natural next step in the company’s development, and we look forward to continuing to build Prisjakt with a broader shareholder base. On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank all our employees for their contributions and extend a warm welcome to our new shareholders.”
Magnus Wiberg, member of the board of directors of Prisjakt and managing partner of eEquity, comments:

“We are proud to have been part of Prisjakt’s development and look forward to remaining shareholders as the company takes its next step. Prisjakt has a leading market position, a strong brand and an established platform for continued growth. We see significant potential in the business and look forward to continuing to support Prisjakt’s development.”
Background and reasons for the Offering

The board of directors of the Company and the main shareholder eEquity believe that a listing of the Company’s ordinary shares on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market is a next step in Prisjakt’s development. The board of directors considers that a listing would increase awareness of Prisjakt and its services, and enhance the Company’s visibility among investors, users and commercial partners. In addition, a public listing would broaden the shareholder base and provide Prisjakt with access to the capital markets, expanding financing options to support continued growth, development and potential acquisitions. Following the Listing, eEquity will remain an engaged owner committed to supporting Prisjakt’s continued growth and has agreed to a lock-up of 540 days. The Company’s medium-term ambition is to work towards a transfer of the listing of its ordinary shares to the regulated market Nasdaq Stockholm.
About Prisjakt

Prisjakt was founded in 2002 and is today one of the leading Nordic providers of comparison-shopping services.[2] It is positioned at the heart of e-commerce as an authority on Nordic retail and enables consumers to make informed purchase decisions through objective comparisons of products, prices, stores, delivery options and historical price trends, while directing high-intent traffic to merchants via paid click-outs. For more than two decades, Prisjakt has collected price and product data as well as insights into consumer shopping behaviour. As of 30 June 2026, Prisjakt’s platform contained structured price and product data for more than 13 million products from over 12,800 merchants. Prisjakt’s platform generated more than 132.8 million and 61.5 million click-outs during the year ending 31 December 2025 and the six-month period ended 30 June 2026, respectively. This corresponds to a click-out growth of 15% for the last twelve months as of 30 June 2026.

Prisjakt’s business model is built on mutual value for both consumers and merchants. By acting as a link between merchants and consumers seeking product information before making a purchase, Prisjakt is well positioned within the consumer product purchasing value chain.

Revenue is generated primarily through click-outs whereby merchants pay a fee for every click-out from the Prisjakt site to the e-commerce stores’ own website. Additional revenue streams include banner advertising on the website and in the app, where advertisers pay for a certain number of impressions, as well as intelligence services providing product, price and marketing intelligence data to merchants and other partners as a monthly subscription.

As of 30 June 2026, Prisjakt delivered price and product information to more than 1.5 million users across Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, the United Kingdom, France, Ireland and New Zealand. For the financial year 1 January–31 December 2025, Prisjakt generated net revenues of SEK 493.1 million and an adjusted EBITDA of SEK 160.9 million, corresponding to a net revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth of 17% and 41%, respectively.[3]
Stabilisation measures

In connection with the Offering and the admission to trading of the Company’s ordinary shares on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market, Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB, as stabilisation manager (“
Stabilisation Manager

”), may effect transactions aimed at supporting the market price of the ordinary shares at levels above those which might otherwise prevail in the open market. Such stabilisation transactions may be effected on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market, in the over-the-counter market or otherwise, at any time during the period starting on the date of commencement of trading in the ordinary shares on Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market and ending not later than 30 calendar days thereafter. The Stabilisation Manager is, however, not required to undertake any stabilisation and there is no assurance that stabilisation will be undertaken.

Stabilisation, if undertaken, may be discontinued at any time without prior notice. In no event will transactions be effected at levels above the price per ordinary share in the Offering. No later than by the end of the seventh trading day after stabilisation transactions have been undertaken, the Stabilisation Manager shall disclose that stabilisation transactions have been undertaken in accordance with article 5(4) in the Market Abuse Regulation (EU) 596/2014. Within one week of the end of the stabilisation period, the Stabilisation Manager will make public whether or not stabilisation was undertaken, the date at which stabilisation started, the date at which stabilisation last occurred and the price range within which stabilisation was carried out, for each of the dates during which stabilisation transactions were carried out.
